EDIT-CANVAS / identity-preserve. Produce exactly ONE 1254×1254 PNG sprite sheet, 2×2 square 627px cells. Image 1 is the edit target. No borders, gutters, text or floor shadows. Do not zoom, crop, mirror, matte or resize the canvas.
Copy the exact character identity, proportions, 470px standing height, local center and baseline from slot 0 into each new cell, changing pose according to the guides and numerical phase specification below. All frames face screen-right E in full right-facing profile; LEFT side toward camera, olive satchel on LEFT hip in front, plain walnut staff with brass ferrules in anatomical RIGHT hand on FAR side, upright with tip above shoulder. Young woman, dark curly hair tied back, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, navy sleeveless tabard with plain chest, ONE diagonal chestnut harness to olive canvas LEFT-hip satchel, ONE belt, laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut boots. No insignia anywhere. Same level head and gaze locked screen-right, never toward camera. Same elevated three-quarter projection camera as reference, character rotation only. Fixed single cold key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing edge. No warm light or spell effects.
HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game: confident dark hand-drawn contour with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean material planes, restrained texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous grain; the line carries the pose. Each image looks like an animation frame. Faction palette blue / ivory / brass; retain exact costume from target.
This is a 12-frame IN-PLACE WALK at 12fps, one full stride with left then right contact. Figures remain centered in their cells. H=470px; x offsets below are relative to body root along screen-right; sole height is above common rest ground baseline. Near = anatomical left / camera side. Far = anatomical right / staff side. Match each guide's planted vs swing sole and head ride. No translation through the cell. Planted sole slides backward under the body as swing foot passes forward. Arms oppose same-side legs, free near arm swings freely while far staff arm swings less with staff upright. Hair and satchel follow motion by a few pixels. Head bobs down into contact and rises through passing, weighty stride.

Keep every character, staff and boot completely inside its cell on the pure green plate.
